summary: Phase 6B.2 Partner Subscriptions, Auto-Licensing & Dual-Tier Rev-Share validated end-to-end. 19/19 backend pytest passing (plans catalog filtering, checkout gating w/ Stripe session creation, idempotent fulfilment + audit_log write, my-subscriptions hydration, rev-share precedence subscription→global_default, regression on prior endpoints). Frontend flows verified live against the preview URL: /partners/subscribe plan picker (community + facilitator dual-tier 70/50, 65/45, 60/40), needs-approval-banner for demo on facilitator tab, Profile required disabled state, LICENSED status card on /dashboard/partner with days-remaining countdown, and /partners/apply facilitator subform banner correctly links to /partners/subscribe?type=facilitator with no 'coming soon' text.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/subscriptions.py create_subscription_from_txn idempotency keyed on payment_session_id (good). Same session_id reused for renewal would silently no-op — acceptable for v1 (renewals are new Stripe sessions).
utils/rev_share.py: _global_default_pct returns tiers[0] only; if foundation_settings ever supports multiple tiers, branching logic will need extension. Documented well; non-blocking.
Test agent typo'd `audit_logs` initially — actual collection is singular `audit_log`. Worth noting consistent collection naming in a follow-up cleanup.

Subscribe button styles use `bg-[#476B6B]` active tab — looks correct. Plan-revshare-{id} testid is reused both for facilitator dual-tier and other types — could cause confusion in unit selectors but works as testid namespace per plan id.
test_credentials: demo@birthright.org / birthright2026 (has approved community partner_profile slug=sam-rivera-community); elena@birthright.org / birthright2026 (no partner profile); admin@birthright.org / birthright2026.
seed_data_creation: Created a synthetic TEST_ partner_subscription doc for demo to verify the LICENSED status card on /dashboard/partner; cleaned up after testing. The pytest session creates 1 real Stripe checkout session for community Annual plan + payment_transactions row + then simulates paid + fulfilment; cleanup fixture deletes these afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 12 subscription_plans seeded in db.subscription_plans. Community global_default rev-share = 10%, facilitator = 72.5%. Backend version 1.8.0. To test fulfilment without real Stripe payment, call `from routers.subscriptions import create_subscription_from_txn; await create_subscription_from_txn(db, txn_with_payment_status_paid)`. The iter10 test file uses this pattern and is idempotent.
verified_flows: GET /api/subscriptions/plans (no filter→12, facilitator→3 with BR_IP+other, community→3 with default_pct, invalid→400)

POST /api/subscriptions/checkout (anon→401, unknown plan→404, demo facilitator→403, demo community→200 with Stripe url + session_id; payment_transactions row inserted with type=subscription, payment_status=initiated, metadata.plan_id/duration_months/partner_profile_id present)

create_subscription_from_txn(db, paid_txn) → creates partner_subscription{status=active, partner_type=community, duration_months=12, expires_at>started_at}; second call idempotent (still 1 row); writes audit_log{action=subscription.activate}
GET /api/subscriptions/my as demo → returns sub with is_active=true, plan populated
GET /api/partners/my-rev-share/community (demo, after fulfilment) → source=subscription, pct=10 (matches Community Annual default_pct), plan_id+expires_at populated
Frontend /partners/subscribe?type=community as DEMO: 3 plan cards ($29/$299/$549), Subscribe enabled (demo has community profile), Most chosen ribbon on annual

Frontend /partners/subscribe?type=facilitator as DEMO: needs-approval-banner shown, 3 plans with dual-tier rev-share displayed (70/50, 65/45, 60/40), Subscribe buttons say 'Profile required' and are disabled
Frontend /dashboard/partner with active community sub: LICENSED card, 180 DAYS LEFT countdown, 'Community — Annual' plan name, Expires 11/19/2026
Frontend /partners/apply facilitator subform: banner text 'After approval you'll choose a subscription plan' with link href /partners/subscribe?type=facilitator (no 'coming soon')
